title: MSqRob for Simple Experimental Designs
markdown:
## What this covers

This chapter covers the statistical principles and workflow for differential protein abundance analysis in label-free quantitative proteomics using MSqRob for two-group designs. It addresses the distinction between experimental and observational units, summarisation methods, and how sample size governs statistical power. The reader is assumed to be familiar with mass spectrometry identification pipelines (such as MaxQuant) and the basics of hypothesis testing.
